data.name: Amanpreet
data.gender_notes: Amanpreet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aman means immortal and preet means precious, love, or affection. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is popular in Hindu cultures. The name Amanpreet carries the meaning “Immortal, Precious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amanpreet usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Amanpreet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amanpreet total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
